A camera surface that opens and cannot decode is a prop; one that half-decodes can name the wrong account. AddWalletDrawer:961 already routes Connect hardware wallet to the working Import Keystone file flow rather than a dead end, and :501 cites this node for the modal shell it does draw. blocked-on-backend is the nearest word the vocabulary has for a dependency call only Casey can make.
